risk_summary: The disclosure identifies substantial operational, supply-chain, labor, pandemic, and end-market risks, including unresolved magnesium and Warrick metal-supply issues. Management presents an optimistic outlook with quantified 2022 targets, but relies heavily on forward-looking assumptions about demand recovery, cost normalization, and operational improvements. Extensive definitions, cross-references, and non-GAAP framing add complexity and may reduce comparability with GAAP results.
